KA-WEWS 
December 1, 1979 


Hi, hope the fall has treated everyone well. Yes, there will be a Xmas party, 
place, date and time will come on a later date. Hopefully we'll see you there. 


The Kanawana Outing Club has started up and we have started getting the budget 
ready for K.K. '80. I'm also hoping to start a Staff Committee to help in 
planning for 1980. If you are interested give Olga or myself a call or drop 
by. Hope to get the Committee rolling in mid-December or early January. 


I've started to talk to people about next summer which is not that far away 
about jobs. By the way if any of you are wondering were those large sums of 
money went this summer maybe you didn't receive that last cheque and I know 
you could use it for Christmas shopping so how about getting in that report:? 
Also, there are a few data cards missing and parents are calling wondering 
what happened to them, so check those trunks they may be lining the bottom 
and I'd appreciate receiving them: 


SOME TIDBITS: 


Remember the K.K. canoe Dave O'Donnell lost from the caboose the early part of 
the summer? Well, its been found hiding on top of the ski hill. I hope there 
was a lesson learnt. 


Bob Woodhouse, Kevin Forster and Katie Sheahan have all started fulltime jobs 
and all seem to be enjoying them. 


Kitti is back from her Xross-Canada tour. Lynn Pryer is holding down two jobs 
in Toronto. Dr. Bob is in New Zealand on part of his world tour. Alan Gandall 
got stroked and is stroking every morning. Therese had a fantastic party which 
I missed. Dave Scammells aparently has a casanova for a roomy at University. 
Hear about Kevin McGrath and Steve Wells' drinking contest. Kevin apparently 
lost his shirt. Ellen Paltiel is a member of a new group. 


That's it, that's all, 


Dave 


=Ja 
Ka-News
